claims.claim: Monumento Natural Los Pingüinos is formed by Isla Magdalena and Isla Marta in the Strait of Magellan, Chile.
Isla Magdalena supports a major breeding colony of Magellanic penguins and other seabirds.
Isla Marta supports imperial cormorants and breeding areas for South American sea lions and fur seals.
Closures, landing rules, schedules and visitor protocols require live verification with CONAF.
